subject: Pilot MAP: approval gate & contract execution sequencing
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot MAP: approval gate & contract execution sequencing

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached is the working MAP and SOW (pilot_map_v3.xlsx; SOW_Astra_v4.pdf). I sketched the approval gates we discussed and the proposed sequencing for signatures so we can meet the target start date of 2027-01-03. High-level asks: 

- Please confirm whether Astra requires an invoice or PO before signature (procurement lane).
- Legal: can you confirm the person who will sign from Astra (name + title) so we can route DocuSign correctly?
- Can you commit to a final Go/No-Go by COB 2026-12-01 so we have time for onboarding and provisioning?

Internal notes (for Marissa/Jonas):
- Proposed internal approval path: AE -> Sales Manager -> Procurement review -> Exec sign-off (if SLA exceptions requested). Exec sign-off window needs to be 11/30–12/01 to hit start date.
- Jonas: I flagged a potential SLA exception in section 2.3 of the SOW — need your OK or redline.

Attachments: pilot_map_v3.xlsx (MAP timeline & owners), SOW_Astra_v4.pdf (SOW with initial terms), SOC2_summary.pdf (requested by procurement previously).

Next steps: Emily, if procurement/legal can confirm the approver and PO timing by Fri 11/27, we can circulate the DocuSign envelope and target signature the week of 11/30.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: pilot_map_v3.xlsx (14KB spreadsheet), SOW_Astra_v4.pdf (25 pages, PDF), SOC2_summary.pdf (3 pages)

From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@astrahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP: approval gate & contract execution sequencing

Vivek —

Thanks for the MAP and SOW. Quick answers from procurement/legal side: 

- We typically need a PO before signing for pilots > $25k. I am confirming whether finance will allow signature-first for a contracted pilot; I should have an answer by Friday (11/27).
- Legal: our general counsel wants a short summary of data controls (SOC2_summary.pdf helps) and the primary signer will likely be me for the pilot scope; final signature for any scaled agreement will go to our VP of Purchasing.

A couple of clarifying Qs: 
1) Is the start date of 2027-01-03 flexible by a week if procurement pushes the PO?
2) On the MAP, section labeled "onboarding window" lists 10 business days — can you compress to 7 if we provide a dedicated integration resource?

We will escalate internally to try and hit your 12/01 Go/No-Go.

Thanks,
Emily Jones
Head of Product Integrations
Astra Health

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP: approval gate & contract execution sequencing

Emily / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Emily. A few tactical items from our side: 

- Start date flexibility: we can accommodate a +/-1 week move to 2027-01-10 if procurement needs the PO first. We prefer to sign and provision earlier if possible but will accept the buffer.
- Onboarding window: we can compress to 7 business days if you provide the integration engineer and grant test data access by day 0 — added a compressed path in pilot_map_v3.xlsx (tab: Onboarding_opt).
- DocuSign: I prepared the envelope (docusign_envelope_12345.link) with the SOW + MAP attachments and a separate pricing redline spreadsheet. If procurement requires a PO pre-signature, we'll mark the envelope as contingent and include the PO reference field.

Jonas — can you confirm the SLA exception status on 2.3? If we can avoid an exec escalation we keep the approval window tight.

Emily, attaching a pricing_redline_20261126.xlsx as discussed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Vivek —

I reviewed section 2.3 (SLA latency target) and can approve the pilot exception we discussed, provided we include a rollback clause in the SOW and the pricing uplift for dedicated capacity is explicit. I have annotated the SOW and commented inline (see SOW_Astra_v4.pdf).

Note: if exec sign-off is required we need the request in by 11/30 for the Dec 1 decision window — I can route to the Ops board on 11/30 morning.

-Jonas

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Astra Health Legal <legal@astrahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Go — schedule for signature, billing, and 2027-01-03 start (contingent)

Emily —

Following internal checks and Jonas's approval of the SLA exception, Redwood is issuing a formal "GO" for the pilot contingent on receipt of either: 1) Astra PO referencing ASTRA-2026-0719, or 2) confirmation of signature authority from your side (you indicated you can sign for the pilot). To keep the schedule we will proceed as follows: 

1) Monday 11/30: DocuSign envelope sent to Emily Jones (envelope: docusign_envelope_12345.link).
2) Target signature window: 12/01–12/03. If PO arrives before signature we will mark the envelope with PO number and finalize billing.
3) If fully signed by 12/03, onboarding provisioning begins 2026-12-15 (pre-provision) and formal pilot start date 2027-01-03. If PO delays beyond 12/03, start date moves to 2027-01-10.
4) Responsibility matrix: 
   - Redwood: env provisioning, playbook handoff, monitoring dashboard access.
   - Astra: integration engineer assignment, test dataset delivery, security contact for KMS/HSM questions.

Next actions for Astra: reply with PO timing or "I will sign" so we can route DocuSign. Please cc legal@astrahealth.com on the reply.

Thanks everyone — moving to close this MAP. I will follow up with a final HubSpot update and attach the signed SOW once complete.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
